mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( user_id, voucher_id, order_date, [status], total_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, shipping_fee, shipping_fullname, shipping_phone, shipping_address, shipping_city, shipping_country, [note], created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{voucherId}, ISNULL(#{orderDate}, GETDATE()), #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalAmount}, #{shippingFee}, #{shippingFullname}, #{shippingPhone}, #{shippingAddress}, #{shippingCity}, #{shippingCountry}, #{note}, GETDATE(), GETDATE() )

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, variant_id, product_name_snapshot, quantity, unit_price, total_price ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{variantId}, #{productNameSnapshot}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, user_id, voucher_id, order_date, [status], total_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, shipping_fee, shipping_fullname, shipping_phone, shipping_address, shipping_city, shipping_country, [note], created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT order_item_id, order_id, variant_id, product_name_snapshot, quantity, unit_price, total_price FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET [status] = #{status}, updated_at = GETDATE() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND [status] = 'PENDING' -- Thêm điều kiện này để an toàn hơn
mapper.select:
SELECT order_id, user_id, voucher_id, order_date, [status], total_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, shipping_fee, shipping_fullname, shipping_phone, shipping_address, shipping_city, shipping_country, [note], created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE 1=1
AND [status] = #{status}
AND (shipping_fullname LIKE ('%' + #{searchTerm} + '%') OR shipping_phone LIKE ('%' + #{searchTerm} + '%') OR CAST(order_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE ('%' + #{searchTerm}) + '%')
ORDER BY order_date DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT pv.product_id AS productId, p.title AS productName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS totalSold FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id -- Phải join qua variants vì order_items không có product_id trực tiếp INNER JOIN product_variants pv ON oi.variant_id = pv.variant_id INNER JOIN products p ON pv.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.[status] IN ('SHIPPING', 'DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY pv.product_id, p.title ORDER BY totalSold DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
